limits.what: A successful command (exit 0, or exit 1 for grep, rg, find, diff, test, git diff, git grep) is returned inline up to about this size.
Past that, a successful command arrives as a file path plus a preview of the first characters.
A failed command is returned inline up to about this size; past that, a head-and-tail excerpt of this size with no file path.
A text result over this size from a tool without anthropic/maxResultSizeChars is saved to a file and replaced by a message naming the path.
The token limit past which an MCP result is saved to a file and replaced by a path message.
Claude Code shows a warning above this size; the output is still passed through.
One Read call returns the whole file up to this size; past it, the first page with a PARTIAL notice.

scenarios.name: Playwright page snapshot via MCP
scenarios.kiasi_gets: the first 6,000 chars and a file path
scenarios.note: Over 50,000 chars Claude Code alone saves the result to a file and sends only a path message, so it sends less than Kiasi's capped head.

scenarios.name: GitHub issue list via MCP
scenarios.kiasi_gets: the first 6,000 chars and a file path
scenarios.note: Over 50,000 chars Claude Code alone saves the result to a file and sends only a path message, so it sends less than Kiasi's capped head.

scenarios.name: npm install log (ANSI, progress bars)
scenarios.claude_code_gets: a file path and the first 2,000 chars
scenarios.kiasi_gets: a cleaned head, the error lines and a tail, and a file path
scenarios.note: Exit 0, so Claude Code alone returns a file path and the first 2,000 chars; Kiasi cleans the log and keeps a head, the error lines and a tail, so it sends more here.

scenarios.name: Session transcript Read (.jsonl)
scenarios.kiasi_gets: the first 8,000 chars and a file path
scenarios.note: The file is under Claude Code's 25,000-token Read limit, so Claude Code alone sends all of it; Kiasi caps session transcripts and other files under ~/.claude.

scenarios.name: Test run through mcp__kiasi__run
scenarios.claude_code_gets: a 10,000-char head and tail, no file path
scenarios.kiasi_gets: a digest with the failing lines and a file path
scenarios.note: A failing test run exits 1, which is a failure for Claude Code: past 10,000 chars it sends a blind head and tail with no path. Kiasi's digest keeps the failing lines and a path.

scenarios.name: Count items in a big JSON via mcp__kiasi__distill
scenarios.note: Without Kiasi, Claude would usually run a one-liner through Bash that prints just the count; the baseline is that tiny output, so there is no saving against it.

scenarios.name: Unchanged source file read a second time
scenarios.kiasi_gets: a one-line pointer to the copy already in context
scenarios.note: Claude Code alone re-sends the whole unchanged file on every re-read in the same conversation; Kiasi answers with a pointer to the copy already in context.

scenarios.name: Mid-size build log (ANSI, progress redraws)
scenarios.kiasi_gets: the log without colour codes and repeated lines, and a file path
scenarios.note: Under 30,000 chars, so Claude Code alone sends all of it, colour codes and progress redraws included; Kiasi strips the noise.

scenarios.name: Mid-size issue list via MCP
scenarios.kiasi_gets: the first 6,000 chars and a file path
scenarios.note: Under 50,000 chars, so Claude Code alone sends all of it; Kiasi keeps a head and a path to the full result.
